author: sentinelpj
quote: This has been one of the worst rugpull of a video game I've ever experienced. The writing is terrible, a significant step down from literally any other GTA installment. The clear restraint in the name of 'political correctness' is the antithesis of what this game franchise has always stood for. It's like the devs spent 13 years and couldn't be bothered to create a branching storyline that allowed any real agency. Don't want to always be asked to please some girlboss ungrateful unloyal chick? sorry. Want to bang some other chick because you like their personality or looks better? sorry. do what your told and be bored while you do it. rockstar has truly fallen, just as all the other western devs that have fallen -- they hate their own customers.
